info.name: LeaveFlow API
info.description: START HERE. The collection needs no environment selected. For the first account, fill adminName, adminEmail, adminPassword, then run Health, Bootstrap Status, Bootstrap First Admin only if setup_required=true, and Login as Admin. After setup, repeatable public Admin registration is available at the login screen and via Public Register Admin below. Each Admin gets a separate workspace and cannot access other Admin workspaces. Public registration grants full Admin access within that workspace; use only for this local demo.

variable.description: Your chosen initial Admin email; use this exact value for Admin login.
Your chosen initial Admin password (at least 8 characters); use this exact value for Admin login.
Your chosen initial Admin display name.
Only needed if backend LEAVEFLOW_BOOTSTRAP_KEY is configured.

item.name: START HERE - Setup & Sign In (run first)
1. Health - confirm the API is running

request.description: Run first. Expect HTTP 200 and status healthy. If it fails, start the backend from the backend folder: python -m uvicorn main:app --reload.

item.name: 2. Bootstrap Status - check whether first Admin setup is needed

request.description: Read setup_required in the response. If true, run Bootstrap First Admin. If false, skip bootstrap and go to Login as Admin.

item.name: 3. Bootstrap First Admin - only if setup_required is true

request.description: Fill adminName, adminEmail, and adminPassword in this collection Variables tab first. Run only when Bootstrap Status returns setup_required=true. This works once per database; do not rerun after setup. If setupKey is configured by the backend, enter it in the collection Variables tab.

item.name: 4. Login as Admin - use the same credentials as Bootstrap

request.description: Run after Admin setup. The email and password must exactly match the values used in Bootstrap First Admin. A 401 means those credentials do not match an account in the database.

item.name: Login as HR - only after an HR account exists

request.description: Run only after an Admin has created an HR account. Create Account saves this account email and password for you.

item.name: Login as Manager - only after a Manager account exists

request.description: Run only after an Admin has created a Manager account. Create Account saves this account email and password for you.

item.name: Login as Employee - only after an Employee account exists

request.description: Run only after HR, an Admin, or an authorized Manager has created an Employee account. Create Account saves this account email and password for you.

Public and repeatable. Set fullName, email, and newPassword in collection Variables. Each registered account is an Admin with full access to a separate workspace; intended only for the local demo. The credentials are saved to adminEmail/adminPassword for the Admin login request.

item.description: Follow the numbered requests in order. After Admin login, create a department and leave type in the next folder before creating accounts.

item.name: Accounts, Departments & Leave Types
List Employees (Admin/HR; Manager sees own team)

request.description: Admin only. Set targetUserId to an account ID and isActive to true or false in collection Variables.
Admin or HR only. Set employeeId and managerId; use null to clear the assigned Manager.

item.name: Create Admin, HR, Manager, or Employee (role permissions apply)

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('joiningDate')) { const now = new Date(); const localDate = new Date(now.getTime() - now.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000).toISOString().slice(0, 10); pm.collectionVariables.set('joiningDate', localDate); }

request.description: A signed-in Admin can create ADMIN, HR, MANAGER, or EMPLOYEE accounts. HR and Managers can create EMPLOYEE accounts only. Set fullName, email, accountRole, designation, and newPassword in collection Variables. Create department and Manager first when needed. Generated employee code and IDs are saved automatically; Admin credentials are also saved for the Login as Admin request.
Admin or HR only. Set departmentName and departmentDescription in collection Variables. Run once; the returned department ID is saved automatically.
Lists only active leave types in the signed-in user's workspace.
Admin or HR only. Set leaveTypeName and yearlyAllowance in collection Variables. Create this before employee accounts to initialize their balances.

item.description: Sign in as Admin first. Create a department and a leave type before creating accounts so new employees receive initial leave balances. The collection saves the department, Manager, employee, and leave-type IDs as requests succeed. Use one account creation request at a time.

item.name: Attendance

request.description: Changes the database. Run once per user per day; a repeat check-in returns an error.
Changes the database. Run after Check In on the same day.

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('selectedDate')) { const now = new Date(); const localDate = new Date(now.getTime() - now.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000).toISOString().slice(0, 10); pm.collectionVariables.set('selectedDate', localDate); }

request.description: Requires the appropriate Manager, HR, or Admin login. The date is filled automatically when blank.

item.description: Login as the role whose attendance you want. Check In succeeds once per day; Check Out requires a successful Check In today. Team / Company Attendance is role-scoped.

item.name: Leave Requests

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('startDate')) { const tomorrow = new Date(); tomorrow.setDate(tomorrow.getDate() + 1); pm.collectionVariables.set('startDate', localDate(tomorrow)); }

request.description: Employee login required. Create a leave type and employee balance first. The date is filled automatically if blank; adjust leaveTypeId if needed.
Login as the assigned Manager, HR, or Admin first. Managers see only requests from their own team.
Requires an authorized Manager, HR, or Admin login and a pending leaveRequestId. Run only once per request.
Requires an authorized Manager, HR, or Admin login and a pending leaveRequestId. Run only once per request.

item.description: Apply as Employee, then log in as the assigned Manager (or HR/Admin) to review. A successful application saves its request ID automatically. Approval/rejection changes database state and can be done only once per pending request.
